merge.defence: SBL-EIAR-20261020-R1 makes M1–M4 explicit conditions of conditional merge approval. §F1 limits repair to those conditions; §F2 prevents adding the donor programme, full trace, host grid, W3 or hygiene as new blockers. This ruling enforces M4 alone rather than escalating unrelated work.

m4.recommendation: Time-box one operator-owned recovery attempt, then request an authorised independent human/procedural route if recovery cannot succeed today. The orchestrator may prepare and request that route, but cannot impersonate the checker, change the required arm unilaterally, or sign its own independent receipt.

options.option: 1. Restart the existing HG-KSEOS VERIFY lane door on 10103 through its supported operator mechanism.
options.friction: Lowest initial intervention if the existing configuration is sound.
options.risk: A restarted process is not proof of a usable model route. Require an actual mandated-route response, matching required_arm and served_arm, before dispatching M4.

options.option: 2. Enable websocket support on the approved relay route.
options.friction: Low to medium; infrastructure operator change.
options.risk: HTTP health/models success does not prove websocket transport. Verify a successful protocol upgrade and an end-to-end checker response. Do not retry the rejected client setting.

options.option: 3. Register gpt-6.1-sol with a genuine matching backend and route.
options.friction: Medium; route/catalogue operator involvement, potentially necessary alongside transport repair.
options.risk: Metadata registration alone cannot fix HTTP 426. Never alias another served model to the mandated slug; verify actual principal identity.

options.option: 4. Authorise a different available checker principal.
options.friction: Medium; explicit acceptance-authority amendment plus a working independent route.
options.risk: Requires documented SoD equivalence, exact approved principal and required_arm == served_arm. The catalogue alone does not establish an authorised or reachable checker.

options.option: 5. Accept a documented procedural alternative executed by an independent human reviewer.
options.friction: Lowest remaining infrastructure dependency, but requires an available independent reviewer and explicit authority signature.
options.risk: The authority must approve the substitution, scope and receipt semantics first. The reviewer must actually examine the frozen subject and evidence, exercise the relevant cases, and sign findings. Record HUMAN_PROCEDURAL_ACCEPTANCE, not model INDEPENDENT_CASE_PASS; a risk waiver alone does not close M4.

licence.recommendation: MIT for owner-controlled original shipped code, conditional on an artifact-scoped rights inventory and the copyright owner's signature. Keep R1 OPEN until those conditions are satisfied.
licence.reasoning: MIT is a low-friction recommendation, not a conclusion that every donor is compatible. Its notice condition requires retaining the copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions. Preserve applicable third-party terms rather than purporting to relicense them. ([opensource.org](https://opensource.org/license/mit?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=openai)) Public availability without a license does not establish permission to use, modify or redistribute material; exclude or obtain permission for unresolved incorporated sources. ([choosealicense.com](https://choosealicense.com/no-permission/?utm_source=openai)) Compatibility remains conditional because the brief supplies no shipped-component license inventory. Do not expand the review to unused donors.
licence.owner_signature: Sign the selected license and copyright holder, authority to license original contributions, reviewed shipped-material inventory, preserved third-party obligations, exclusions/quarantines, and exact artifact/source SHA covered. If unresolved incorporated obligations remain, retain release HOLD rather than signing an unsupported compatibility assertion.

An eventual R1–R3-complete preview is STANDALONE_ONLY unless separately authorised native evidence exists. Production and SWOF W3 remain NOT_GRANTED.
risks: The supplied brief is the factual basis for repository and CI state; this ruling does not claim fresh remote verification or execution.
An orchestrator with no checker lane cannot honestly complete independent acceptance alone. If neither an independent human nor a functioning authorised route is available, the merge hold persists.
The relative ordering of infrastructure repair options is a triage recommendation, not a claim that any repair is sufficient by itself.
M2 and M3 require independent confirmation despite green maker and hosted tests.
A procedural substitution requires explicit acceptance-authority approval; the owner's pre-authorisation of this ruling is not a fabricated checker receipt.
Licensing compatibility is unproven until the shipped-material inventory is reviewed; private-corpus possession and public repository visibility are insufficient.
Any candidate-tree change after freeze creates a new SHA and requires evidence/receipt rebinding with proportionate delta verification.
Branch archival, deletion, merge and release commands are planned actions only; none was executed in this read-only session.
